purpose: Facts retained for later address/height/facade matching; not all are used in v002 massing.

notes.fact: A two-story brick building was erected in 1925; the second story was removed in 1958 when the bank acquired the entire building.
The current 604 site includes lots formerly numbered 606 and 608; numbering was revised in the early 1970s.
The 605/607 building historically had three- and two-story portions; upper stories were removed in 1962 after the Anthony's fire.
The former hotel was demolished in the late 1960s; the site was a parking lot until the current-era New York Life building appeared around 2000.
The earlier building burned in March 1962 and the site was rebuilt as the V-Store in the mid-1960s.
The site became Merchants Bank in 1915 and later Spink County Bank; City Hall has occupied it since 1980.
